servers.description: All available Coralogix MCP tools. Connects to the region set in the integration's API URL (e.g. https://api.eu2.coralogix.com), see https://coralogix.com/docs/integrations/coralogix-endpoints/#management-endpoints. Note: Coralogix MCP queries only archive storage, so logs kept only in Frequent Search return no results. Connect an S3 archive to your Coralogix account, see https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/mcp-server/limitations/.
